findings.description: Same PISCES cull list as M1; data source compliant with task.md HARD
seq2pair donor-patch Δ=-0.017 (p=0.083, N=176): fails both Δ≥0.2pp and p<0.05 predicates. Effect is 20x smaller than M1 s-patch (Δ=-0.862).

pair_to_sequence hook assumes output shape [B,L,S] but actual shape is [B,num_heads,L,L,32]. Shape mismatch exception aborts pair2seq/zero-ablation/matched-ctrl for 531/534 attempts. Only 3 records each written.
pair2seq (N=3), zero-ablation (N=3), matched-ctrl (N=3) — all insufficient for any statistical inference. Paired McNemar p<0.05 test impossible.

Evidence status: evidence-incomplete (implementation-broken, not statistically underpowered). Three specificity controls are absent — cannot distinguish seq2pair-specific vs non-specific pathway perturbation.

fix_recommendation: Fix pair_to_sequence hook in scripts/m2_worker.py to handle [B,num_heads,L,L,32] shape; re-run M2 (~1 GPU-h) in iteration round 1
